headline: Shortcuts that make the machine feel like yours
body: **Gmail Shortcuts:** Settings → See all settings → 'Keyboard shortcuts on'. Hit `?` inside Gmail anytime to see the cheat sheet.
**Hot Corners (macOS):** System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Hot Corners. Map top-right to Mission Control, bottom-right to Quick Note, etc.
**Mission Control Desktops:** add multiple Spaces (Ctrl+↑ → `+`). Three-finger swipe left/right to swap work contexts instantly.
**▣** **[AppCleaner](https://freemacsoft.net/appcleaner/)** – drag an app in and it removes hidden support files so your Mac stays lean.

headline: Keep the browser clean
body: **▣** **[Brave Browser](https://brave.com/)** – Shields + built-in blocking means YouTube with no ads (turn on Aggressive filtering in Settings → Shields).
**▣** **[NextDNS](https://nextdns.io/)** – custom DNS that nukes trackers at the network level.
Pair them and most autoplay noise disappears.

headline: 💡 Design Cheat Codes
body: Shortcuts the pros use

headline: The 2-Font Rule
body: Use a **maximum of two fonts** in a design.
One for headings (display or serif), one for body (clean sans-serif).
If you absolutely must add a third, use it for a single specialty element only.
This creates instant visual harmony and prevents chaos.

headline: The 60-30-10 Color Rule
body: **60% Dominant color** - Backgrounds, main containers
**30% Secondary color** - Text, minor elements, sidebars
**10% Accent color** - Call-to-action buttons, links, highlights
Stolen from interior design, works perfectly for UI/web.

headline: White Space is Free Real Estate
body: Give elements room to breathe (negative space).
Makes designs feel professional, clean, intentional.
Guides the eye to what matters most.
When in doubt, **add more space**.

headline: Steal the Crop
body: Don't use stock photos as-is. **Crop aggressively**.
Focus on a single compelling detail.
Create interesting negative space for text.
This is how pros make stock photos not look like stock photos.

headline: Duplicate and Simplify
body: Need a new version? **Never work on the only copy**.
Duplicate your design, then **delete half the elements**.
Simplifying a copy often leads to a better, more focused result.
Saves you from 'save as v2 v3 final FINAL' hell.

headline: Build a Swipe File
body: Screenshot or save designs you admire.
When stuck, browse your file for inspiration.
**Analyze why they work**, don't just copy them.
Your future self will thank you.

headline: Contrast by Weight, Not Just Size
body: Don't just make headings **bigger**, make them **bolder**.
Weight contrast (heavy/bold vs regular/light) is more powerful than size alone.
Creates stronger hierarchy without shouting.
Easier to read, looks more sophisticated.

headline: Compression in Numbers
body: Ratios are poetry disguised as math. They’re shortcuts to harmony.

pillars.title: 60/30/10 Rule
pillars.text: Main tone, secondary support, accent spark. Works for color, layout, and sound.

pillars.title: 80/20 Rule
pillars.text: Eighty percent of the impact comes from twenty percent of the elements. Find your heavy hitters.

pillars.title: Rule of Thirds
pillars.text: Balance your grid by dividing your frame into threes: simplicity through geometry.

pillars.title: Golden Ratio (1.618)
pillars.text: Use sparingly; it’s sacred math, not a religion. Trust your eye over your ruler.

headline: Type Is Voice
body: Typography is music for people who read with their eyes.

pillars.title: Pair with Purpose
pillars.text: One loud font, one calm font. Let them play call and response.

pillars.title: Hierarchy Heals
pillars.text: Contrast makes meaning. Don’t whisper what should shout.

pillars.title: Type as Texture
pillars.text: Sometimes legibility is overrated. Feeling > reading.

pillars.title: Never Stretch Type
pillars.text: You’re not God. Don’t warp Helvetica.

headline: Grids Keep You Honest
body: Grids aren't prisons, they're trampolines.

pillars.title: Respect Margins
pillars.text: Whitespace is oxygen. If you’re suffocating, pull back.

pillars.title: Align to Rhythm
pillars.text: Every good layout has a beat. Even punk posters.

pillars.title: One Weird Element
pillars.text: Break your grid once to prove you built it.

pillars.title: Symmetry Is Optional
pillars.text: Tension is what keeps the eye awake.

headline: Unwritten But Universal
body: Every design problem is just a confidence problem wearing different pants.

pillars.title: Law of Intention
pillars.text: If you don’t define your vibe, someone else will.

pillars.title: Law of Economy
pillars.text: Spend effort where it pays dividends: aesthetics that scale.

pillars.title: Law of Play
pillars.text: If it’s not fun, the audience can tell.

pillars.title: Law of Persistence
pillars.text: Everything great was embarrassing halfway through.

headline: 📐 Design Principles
body: Laws and patterns that matter

headline: The Pareto Principle (80/20 Rule)
body: **80% of results come from 20% of effort.**
Focus on the features/elements that deliver the most impact.
Perfect is the enemy of shipped.
Ruthlessly cut the stuff that doesn't move the needle.

headline: You've got to be seen to be heard
body: Visibility creates opportunity.
If people can't find your work, it doesn't matter how good it is.
Consistency beats perfection every time.
Show up, ship often, stay findable.

headline: One thing, done right
body: Tools that do one thing perfectly beat Swiss Army knife apps.
Reduce friction until the tool disappears.
Compression is respect for attention.
Not every good idea needs to scale.

headline: Build the thing that builds the things
body: Meta-systems beat monuments.
Templates, patterns, and infrastructure enable rapid deployment.
Design systems save time in the long run.
Invest in scaffolding, not just output.

**The Mountain Is You** by Brianna Wiest – self-sabotage breaker for creative ruts.
**The Music Lesson** by Victor Wooten – intuition, groove, and listening as craft.
**Why Greatness Cannot Be Planned** by Kenneth O. Stanley & Joel Lehman – curiosity over objectives.
**The Book of the SubGenius** – holy scripture of Slack and joyful disobedience.
**[KLF: The Manual](https://galaxybrains.s3.amazonaws.com/The-Manual.pdf)** – blueprint for DIY releases + culture hacking.

headline: More brain fuel
body: Anything by **Lynda Barry** – fearless prompts + comics that rewire your brain.
**Graphic Classics** (Phaidon) – chunky, visual encyclopedia of layouts and typography.
**Craphound** clip-art books + zines – meticulously curated, remixable artwork.
**Adam Curtis films** – stream them free and remember systems are always weirder than they look.
**[Daily Calvin & Hobbes](https://www.gocomics.com/calvinandhobbes)** – subscribe for a daily strip of soul fuel.

headline: You don't need expensive tools to make great work
body: Everything in this deck is free or has a solid free tier.
Cheat codes are just compression, minmaxing.
Mix stuff, steal respectfully.
Remember: If you think, you stink.
